description: Which NDCs match this drug name, and what do pharmacies pay for them? NADAC search by name (e.g. “atorvastatin 40”) with NDC counts and current per-unit cost ranges, from CMS’s weekly NADAC file. Matches the words of a name (each as a prefix, e.g. "atorvastatin 40") against the NDC descriptions in the latest weekly NADAC file, best match first, and gives each description’s pricing unit, classification, number of NDCs, current per-unit NADAC range and up to five NDCs to look up with drug.nadac. Updated weekly. Price: $0.01 per call. Free tier: 3 free calls a day per IP, at most 3 rows per answer, taken by an unpaid call unless its _meta["distill/free-tier"] is "skip". Confidence: Freshness only (the values are CMS’s, read deterministically): 1 until 9 days after the latest weekly file’s as-of date, then halving every 14 days. National Average Drug Acquisition Cost as CMS publishes it weekly: a survey average of what retail pharmacies pay per unit, not a retail price, a reimbursement rate, a quote or medical advice. See /terms.
